properties.description: Extends the edge-type readings to all 213 relationship-bearing items, backfilled from the three-graph classification; one vocabulary of primitives and operator kinds shared with StoryFlow; a schema check that fails on a missing reading, an out-of-vocabulary primitive or operator, or a name whose reading collides with StoryFlow's.
properties.name: Every relationship-bearing item — edge, pointer, type, status, time and ordering field, relation-node — carries a declared reading in the vocabulary shared with StoryFlow, and a check fails on a missing reading or a cross-system collision
